secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Resend API key so contact-form submissions are also emailed; without it messages are stored in Postgres only.

secrets.name: CONTACT_TO_EMAIL
secrets.description: Optional. Inbox that receives contact-form notifications when RESEND_API_KEY is set.

secrets.name: CONTACT_FROM_EMAIL
secrets.description: Optional. From address for contact notifications (must be verified in Resend). Defaults to the Resend onboarding sender.
